verses.text: The LORD's message came to me:
"Son of man, you are living among rebellious people. They have eyes to see but do not see, and ears to hear but do not hear, because they are a rebellious people.

So, son of man, pack your belongings as if you were going into exile. In the daytime, while they watch, set out and go from where you are to another place. Maybe they will understand, even though they are a rebellious people.
During the day, while they watch, bring out your belongings packed for exile. Then in the evening, while they watch, go out like people going into exile.
While they watch, dig through the wall and carry your belongings out through it.
While they watch, put them on your shoulder and carry them out at dusk. Cover your face so that you cannot see the land, because I have made you a sign to the people of Israel."

So I did as I was told. During the day I brought out my belongings packed for exile. In the evening I dug through the wall with my hands. At dusk I carried my things out on my shoulder while they watched.
In the morning the LORD's message came to me:
"Son of man, didn't the people of Israel, that rebellious people, ask you, 'What are you doing?'
Tell them, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: This message is about the prince in Jerusalem and all the people of Israel who live there.'
Say, 'I am a sign to you. What I have done will be done to them. They will go into exile as captives.
The prince among them will put his things on his shoulder at dusk and leave. A hole will be dug in the wall for him to go through. He will cover his face so he cannot see the land.
I will spread my net over him, and he will be caught in my trap. I will bring him to Babylon, the land of the Babylonians, but he will not see it, and there he will die.
I will scatter to every wind all those around him, his staff and all his troops, and I will chase them with a drawn sword.
They will know that I am the LORD when I scatter them among the nations and spread them throughout the countries.
But I will let a few of them survive the sword, famine, and disease, so that in the nations where they go they may tell about all their disgusting practices. Then they will know that I am the LORD.'"
The LORD's message came to me:
"Son of man, tremble as you eat your food, and shake with fear as you drink your water.

Tell the people of the land, 'This is what the Lord GOD says about those living in Jerusalem and in the land of Israel: They will eat their food with worry and drink their water in despair, because their land will be stripped of everything in it because of the violence of all who live there.
The towns where people live will be ruined, and the land will become a wasteland. Then you will know that I am the LORD.'"
The LORD's message came to me:
"Son of man, what is this saying you have in the land of Israel: 'Time goes by, and every vision comes to nothing'?
So tell them, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: I will put an end to this saying, and they will no longer quote it in Israel.' Tell them instead, 'The time is near when every vision will come true.
For there will be no more false visions or flattering predictions among the people of Israel.
For I am the LORD. I will speak, and what I say will be done without further delay. In your own lifetime, you rebellious people, I will say the word and carry it out, says the Lord GOD.'"
The LORD's message came to me:
"Son of man, the people of Israel are saying, 'The vision he sees is for many years from now. He is prophesying about the distant future.'
So tell them, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: None of my words will be delayed any longer. Whatever I say will be done, says the Lord GOD.'"
